name: Unzip project

on:
  push:
    paths: ['*.zip']
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  unzip:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Unpack zip into repo root
        run: |
          shopt -s nullglob
          zips=(./*.zip)
          if [ ${#zips[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "No zip in repo root, nothing to do"; exit 0; fi
          rm -rf /tmp/unz && mkdir /tmp/unz
          for z in "${zips[@]}"; do unzip -q -o "$z" -d /tmp/unz; rm -f "$z"; done
          # if the archive holds a single top folder (BlissAi-main), use its contents as the project root
          dirs=(/tmp/unz/*/)
          src=/tmp/unz
          if [ ${#dirs[@]} -eq 1 ] && [ -z "$(find /tmp/unz -maxdepth 1 -type f)" ]; then src="${dirs[0]}"; fi
          rm -rf "$src"/.github
          cp -a "$src"/. .

      - name: Commit
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions"
          git config user.email "actions@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --quiet && { echo "No changes"; exit 0; }
          git commit -m "Update project from zip"
          git push
